messages:
Kayla: Quick sync — running the SI pilot with NorthStar next Wed-Thu. Goal: certify 4 SI engineers, validate hardware voucher flow, and a short joint announcement template. Need final lab schedule + voucher ops. Who can host office hours?
Devon: I can run the hands-on lab demo Wed 11:00 AM PT. Will walk Dedicated vs Private deploys and a smoke perf test. Need voucher codes by Tue EOD to hand out.
Ashok: I'll own voucher distribution. Plan to use single-use GPU vouchers. I have a partnerops script ready.
Maria: Also we should update the marketplace listing checklist in the playbook so SIs can follow step-by-step. Adding a link to the reference right now: https://redwood.ai/si-playbook
partners-bot: Reminder: create voucher pool in PartnerOps: `/create-voucher --count 10 --expiry 30d`
Devon: Ashok — can you paste the exact command you'll run so we can include it in the runbook?
Ashok: Sure — here's the command I'll run in PartnerOps: ```/partnerops create-vouchers --partner northstar --count 10 --type gpu-voucher --tags "si-pilot" --single-use true```
Kayla: Perfect. @Maria can you add a micro-cert checkpoint? One hands-on task should be: deploy a model to Dedicated, run perf smoke test, and validate canary rollback.
Maria: Added the checkpoint. Also adding an explicit "rollback test" step so SIs validate canary policies. Updating the playbook doc and checklist now.
partners-bot: Voucher pool created: https://partners.redwood/vouchers/PN-8732 (10 vouchers, expires 2026-04-10)
Devon: For office hours: suggest Zoom + shared terminal (tmate) and record session. We'll keep the agenda tight: 15m intros, 45m lab, 15m Q&A.
Jules: I can handle recordings + transcript + upload to the partner repo.
Kayla: OK action items recap: Devon -> lab demo Wed 11am PT; Ashok -> create vouchers by Tue EOD; Maria -> update playbook + add rollback checkpoint; Jules -> recording + transcript; Partners ops (Ashok) -> confirm marketplace checklist link in the repo. Anything else?
Maria: :thumbsup:
Ashok: :rocket: I'll post confirmation when the vouchers are live and attach the codes to the invite.
Devon: I'll add calendar invite and agenda, include runbook links and the tmate snippet.
partners-bot: Calendar invite created: https://cal.redwood/meet/si-pilot-2420013377
Kayla: Thanks team. One more: we should prepare a short internal comms + joint announcement template to use if pilot goes well. Keep it draft until we have metrics (engagement, deploy success, perf).
Maria: I'll draft a one-pager for PR + partner channel and share for review by Fri.
Devon: Great — will add a small prompt set we used for perf smoke so QA can reproduce.
Kayla: Closing — I'll follow up with a status check Tue morning. Thanks everyone.
